title: Well-posedness and vanishing rotational limit for the rotating incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in hybird Besov space
summary: We establish the well-posedness of the 3D rotating incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with critical initial data $u_{0,Ω}\in X_{0,q,p}^Ω$ for $p<5$, where $X_{0,q,p}^Ω$ is defined by the norm \begin{equation*} \begin{aligned} &\|u_{0,Ω}\|_{X_{0,q,p}^Ω}:= Ω^{3- \frac{6}{q}}\|u_{0,Ω}\|_{\dot{B}_{q,\infty}^{-7+\frac{15}{q}}}^{\ell_Ω} +\|u_{0,Ω}\|_{\dot{B}_{p,\infty}^{-1+\frac{3}{p}}}^{h_Ω}. \end{aligned} \end{equation*} This extends the previous results by Chen, Miao, and Zhang (\cite{CMZ2013}).
